_about: Hand-chosen deletions for experiment 001b. Each entry names a reply id and the exact substrings to delete from its ORIGINAL text. Each substring must occur exactly once in the original unless 'occurrence' is given. Spans may not overlap. harness/apply_mask_edits.py applies these to runs/house/raw.ndjson and writes work/masked.jsonl. Replies not listed here are copied unchanged. The 'n' field is the reply's 0-based position in raw.ndjson, for reading only. An entry may also carry 'capitalize': single-letter capitals at a sentence start left small by a deletion, each as {from, to} differing only in the case of the first letter (the one non-deletion the rules allow).
